fullPassage: The act of improvisation, when it enters our thoughts, is generally contextualized within the realm of the arts. A group of jazz musicians gather without any sheet music and invent music that’s never been heard before, and actors venture onto stages or in front of cameras and perform scenes without a script, making up the dialogue and actions on the spot. In both cases, each set of performers finds artistic success ―they entertain their audiences through improvisation, by creating something new in the moment. However, this skill is not confined to artistic endeavors; it proves equally useful in negotiations, where, for negotiators, there is no script —only a stage. Negotiators can’t plan for all the possible directions a negotiation might take, nor can they predict the changing demands of the other party. Improvisation empowers them to think on their feet and thrive in fluctuating circumstances so that they can maintain a position of strength throughout the negotiation process. To improvise effectively, negotiators, like musicians and actors, must actively listen. The ability to listen is what allows a negotiator to identify the interests of the other party and respond appropriately to work toward a mutually beneficial resolution. Attentive listening also builds trust and encourages sincere participation from everyone involved. It shows the other party that the negotiator is willing to cooperate in helping them achieve their objectives rather than trying to just dominate the negotiation. Employing improvisation instead of a set pattern of reasoning further frees the mind to pursue divergent thinking, which can help negotiators come up with out-of-the-box solutions that otherwise would not be available.

questions.passage: The act of improvisation, when it enters our thoughts, is generally contextualized within the realm of the arts. A group of jazz musicians gather without any sheet music and invent music that’s never been heard before, and actors venture onto stages or in front of cameras and perform scenes without a script, making up the dialogue and actions on the spot. In both cases, each set of performers finds artistic success ―they entertain their audiences through improvisation, by creating something new in the moment. However, this skill is not confined to artistic endeavors; it proves equally useful in negotiations, where, for negotiators, there is no script —only a stage. Negotiators can’t plan for all the possible directions a negotiation might take, nor can they predict the changing demands of the other party. Improvisation empowers them to think on their feet and thrive in fluctuating circumstances so that they can <u>maintain</u> a position of strength throughout the negotiation process. To improvise effectively, negotiators, like musicians and actors, must actively listen. The ability to listen is what allows a negotiator to identify the interests of the other party and respond appropriately to work toward a mutually beneficial resolution. Attentive listening also builds trust and encourages sincere participation from everyone involved. It shows the other party that the negotiator is willing to cooperate in helping them achieve their objectives rather than trying to just dominate the negotiation. Employing improvisation instead of a set pattern of reasoning further frees the mind to pursue divergent thinking, which can help negotiators come up with out-of-the-box solutions that otherwise would not be available.

③ break(깨뜨리다) — 유지와 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 주어 Improvisation이 3인칭 단수라서 현재형 동사에 -s를 붙여 empowers로 써야 함
det.analysis:
빈칸은 문장의 동사 자리예요. 주어 Improvisation(즉흥)은 셀 수 없는 단수 개념이라 3인칭 단수로 취급해요
그래서 현재형 동사에 -s를 붙인 empowers가 정답이에요. empower를 그대로 두면 단수 주어와 수가 맞지 않아 틀려요
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어 + 현재형 동사 → 동사에 -s (empower → empowers)

questions.passage: __________ (employ) improvisation instead of a set pattern of reasoning further frees the mind to pursue divergent thinking. This can help negotiators come up with out-of-the-box ideas.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 문장의 주어 자리이고 뒤에 목적어(improvisation)가 오므로, 동사를 동명사 Employing(~하는 것)으로 바꿔야 함
det.analysis:
빈칸은 문장 맨 앞 주어 자리예요. 그런데 바로 뒤에 목적어 improvisation이 오고, 그 전체가 동사 frees의 주어가 돼요
동사를 그대로 주어로 쓸 수 없으니, '~하는 것'이라는 뜻의 동명사 Employing으로 바꿔야 해요. '즉흥을 활용하는 것이 마음을 자유롭게 한다'는 뜻이 돼요
det.tip: 동사가 주어 자리에 오면 동명사(-ing)로: employ → Employing (~하는 것)

det.korean: a mutually beneficial resolution=상호 이익이 되는 해결책

① a position of total dominance(완전한 지배) — 지배가 아니라 협력을 강조하므로 반대
② a mutually beneficial resolution(상호 이익이 되는 해결책) ✅ 정답 — 서로에게 이로운 결말
③ a fixed and rigid agenda(고정되고 경직된 의제) — 즉흥·유연성 강조와 모순
④ a one-sided personal victory(일방적 개인의 승리) — 상호 이익과 반대
det.tip: identify interests + cooperate → 서로에게 이로운 a mutually beneficial resolution
